text: Audit web-01: deploy password logins from 54.36.199.108 every few hours since start of logs (Oct 29), no failures, only short commands; no sudo use, no file changes found. Looks like the legacy script mentioned in handover; not treated as compromise but flagged. Weaknesses: sudo rsync for deploy (root escalation, never used), jpark (ex-contractor, not in staff list) in sudo group + WP admin, PHP runs in uploads, unauthenticated mu-plugin agency-support.php (?asup=), mailing-export follows symlinks as root (chown arbitrary file).

web-01 fixed: removed deploy sudo rsync; jpark locked (shell nologin, expired, removed from sudo, WP admin role removed + sessions destroyed); nginx denies .php in uploads; mu-plugin agency-support.php moved to /root/quarantine; mailing-export writes CSV as the requesting user (no root write/chown through symlinks). Backups in /root/quarantine.

ci-01: no sign of intrusion (all logins are known staff from usual IPs). Fixed: maint job ran 'git gc --auto' as root in developer-writable repo (pre-auto-gc hook = root); now runs as deploy with core.hooksPath=/dev/null. Repo config with GitHub token was 664 (world-readable); now 640 root:developers. jpark (ex-contractor) locked. backups key restricted to from=10.20.0.20 + no forwarding/pty. Latent switches SOURCE=site (curl|sh as root) and METHOD=agent (ssh -A) are left off.

db-01: no sign of intrusion. Logins: mreyes, nvega, rnakamura, pshah, dana from their usual IPs/office/VPN. Jobs ok. MariaDB grants are narrow (wp_larkspur -> wordpress only; billing_app -> billing from web-01 only). Secrets files root 600. No changes made here; no secret rotated (no evidence of exposure). Stripe key copies: billing.payment_providers, /etc/larkspur/gateway.env here, /etc/larkspur/payments.ini on web-01 — all must change together if ever rotated.

COMPROMISE: nvega's key nv-x13 (SHA256:u8ddy4...) used from 174.205.16.153 concurrently with real nvega at 24.30.177.29; jumped via web-01 to db-01 and deleted all plain dumps (sudo find -mtime -8 -delete at 16:25:32). Contained by restricting nvega keys with from= (home IP + office net) on all 3 hosts.
